The office of the **Governor of Vatican City State** (*Governatore dello Stato della Città del Vaticano*) ended on **March 21, 1952**.

The only person to hold this specific title was **Camillo Serafini**, who served from the founding of the state in 1929 until his death. Upon his death on March 21, 1952, the office was immediately abolished and its functions were taken over by the Pontifical Commission for Vatican City State.
